item.description:
App-wide visual pass: shared effects, Dashboard cleanup, EVE-style theming

General:

  • eveSelectionGlow: one theme-accent glow for selected rows and cards
  • Symbol effects (bounce, wiggle, pulse, breathe), scroll reveal, completion ping
  • EVERollIn: headline figures roll in from their leading digit (same width)
  • eveStandingRing: friend-or-foe ring on portraits, identity-stable

Dashboard:

  • Replace the Players/NPCs/Organizations contact sections with a compact Watched strip
  • Selected-pilot glow, scroll reveal on pilot and news cards
  • Briefing items get stable IDs; new items bounce. Server icon pulses when degraded
  • Pilot card ticks every 15s instead of every second

Screens:

  • Training: selection glow on group and queue rows, portrait backdrop, ping when

the skill in training finishes

  • Location: ship backdrop under a light security-color wash with a security strip;

Ship column no longer breaks labels; Station Services neutral except key services

  • Galaxy Map HUD tinted by security; Assets show station security
  • Local Intel, Killmails and Contacts ring portraits by standing (StandingsIndex)

App:

  • Sidebar: unread counts on Mails and Communications (ActivitySignals), wiggle on new arrivals, bounce on badge changes; online ring on the pilot portrait
  • Faction crest on the Dock icon and themed Dock progress ring
  • Empty states breathe over a faint faction crest
  • Hover on ~30 clickable cards and rows; skeletons replace 10 list/detail spinners
  • EVEChartStyle shared by all charts; hover readouts on market history and population
